params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box or column. Some properties (marked with * in the doc) only apply to columns; if a whole list box is passed for one of those, the property is applied to each of its columns.

params.name: property
params.description: Constant (List Box theme, e.g. lk allow wordwrap, lk column max width, lk display header...) designating the property to set.

params.name: value
params.description: New value of property; its expected type/range depends on which property constant was passed (e.g. Boolean-like lk no/lk yes constants, a numeric size, or an expression reference).

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the value of the given property of the designated list box or column.

constraints: If the designated list box or column does not exist, or the property does not exist or isn't available for that object (e.g. a column-only property passed to an array-type list box), the command does nothing and no error is triggered.
